content: Pitambed Komo Kamoon Kuu Daandoon
Kwane, Yuudanban kangkon God ye weng wengambere anam andiwen kuye weng kuu apasodan yoom anam andidan yena yoom Yudea korem aom doriib kuu wengambiriwen.
Kowe, Pita kuu ika Yerusalem ari yaro wonoona, Yuudan anam andiwen yenambed ye yaa wengberenib
yedmiwen, “Eb kuu wenene karub kad wadmindo yambiwoom wene yi yoom animan ane doberewen kii.” andiwen.
Kwane, Pitambed korem komo keroon ye weng id kuu yi yaa korobe kedmengkande yedmoon,
“Ne kuu Yopa taun aom kurikuri kamoni wane wedmaane, kenbas areb darewoob bendom kaningiib bingiwen kumbed ambid aombed kankamene neyiib yaa muneen.
Kwane, aom wedmaan kuu dingkan amongkowiib dingkan kiiwiib yiyiib ayari oniib kuu kwane wedmaan.
Kwane, wengambaraane wengmo baandoon, ‘Pita! Eb dembe, dingkan kuu mayen ane.’ andoon.
Andoona, nembed inande yedmaan, ‘Yariman, anainban! Amowamobbed anaib andoon ye animan arewa o animokban ye dingkan kuu ne mongkodkono ma awunindo.’ andaan.
Kwane, angkon wengmo baande yedmoon, ‘Godbed komo komo yaa yimin andoon kuu ebbed arewa andaab.’ andoon.
Kuu kwane kame ayoobmimiib kere ika kan ambid ari daanoon.
“Kwane kuyaambed, karub ayoobmimiib Saesaria yaambed ne yaa yuk meniib kuu mene nembed ambib doriin kuyaa yinmone doriib.
Kwane, Kingkin Karadmombed yedmewoon, ‘Eb kuu kerebkarab kamaab, yi yoom wene.’ andoon kowe, kwane angkodmi benmeyiib yi yoom wunuwen. Kwane wene Koonelius yambiwoom aomnuwen.
Aomnuuwe, yembed nub yaa daandoon kuu uniya engyu kuu yambiwoom angkadere ye yaa yedmenoon, ‘Yopa angka yuk kowebko Saimon yaningko maa Pita ande nenminime.
Kwane, yembed weng kuu kanmananeen kuu eb yoom eb ambiwoom doriibdan korem yoom kuu wengambere anam andaniib kuu Godbed yiib bobni yaa kuu burudande bindaneen.’ andoon kowe Kooneliusbed daawoon.
“Kwane, ne andowe dakmaana, andowoon yiri nub yaa Kingkin Karadmo monoon kwane yi yaa kwangkon monoon.
Kwanoona, nembed ika meenaan Yarimanbed yedmoon kuu, ‘Yoonbed kuu okiib baptais kerundimaan, kumban yiib kuu Godbed Kingkin Karadmoyiib baptais kerundaneen.’ andoon.
Kwane, yi kuu Yariman Yesu Keresu yaa anam andiiwe, Godbed yi yaa Kingkin Karadmoyiib kondoon kuu ibmo nub yaa kondoon areb kowe, God yaa kwamaab ande yedmaniin dee? Dowan!” andoon.

Kwane, Yuudan anam andiwen kuu weng kee wengamberekorib, yi bokwangki korondenib kwane God yaa kubekoriwa yedmiwen, “Kwane kowe, amonombe wadkeri aron korem korem kandi ye kiwaan Godbed ongmoon kuu Yuudanban kwangkon yiman ande kowoon kii.” andiwen.
Anam Andiwendan Antiok Aom
Stiwin ayiiwe anam andiwendan kuyaambed kirokmone buyokbayok keriwendan kuu wene ambibkin Fonisia kere dudbi darewoob Saipurus kere Antiok taun aom kere kuu Yuudan yaamo Yesu ye weng amun dakmiwen.
Kumban Saipurusdan yena yoom Sairindan yena yoom anam andiwen kumbed Antiok aom wene Yuudanban yaa Yariman Yesu ye weng amun dakmenabiwen.
Yi kuu Godbed yaromkonoyiib kondoon kowe, nimakarub miin yemoon mene wengamberekorib, amonombe Yariman yaa anam andiwen.
Yirin weng kee wene Yerusalem aombed anam andiwendan yi kerendem aom aomnoona wengamberekorib, Baanabas nen Antiok yaa kowiiwa wonoon.

Baanabas kuu karub amun, ye kuu God ye Kingkin Karadmo ibenooniib anam andi darewoowiib, kui. Kowe, wene Antiok nandekore, wedmoon kuu anam, nimakarub kibireb anam andiwen yaa kuu Godbed amun kerundoon kowe, kubiyiibbed yi yaa andemendoon kuu niindem aom kangdommo kere God yaamo meenimo dobirime kwane ande dakmoon. Kwane, weng amuniib dakmenaboone, nimakarub yemoon bin Yariman ye kiwaan yiri benmonoon.
Kwanekore, Baanabas kuu Taasus yaa Sool ande onmen wonoon.

Kwane, wedmenekore, Antiok yaa nenmonoon. Kwane, weeb mimo kuu Baanabas yoom Sool yoom kuu anam andidan yemooniib nedbe kedmengkandimaib. Kwane kuye aron Antiok yaambed, Yesu ye kedmengkandeendan yaa kuu kuristen
ande dakmimaib.
Kuye aron kuyaambed, profesidan yena Yerusalem arimbed Antiok yaa miniwen.

Yi aom kuu karub maa yaningko kuu Agabus kuu Kingkin Karadmombed yedmenoona dakmoon, “Romdanbed ooniwen ye ambibkin korem aom kuu am manaanban kerene animaniibban mungimo dobaraniib.” ande dakmoon. (Kee anam ku kwanoon kuyaron kuu Klaudiusbed Saesaa keroon yaron.)
Kwane, anam andiwendan keyaa doriib kumbed wengamberekorib, anam andiwendan Yudea aom doriib awandi ye dowad, yi yaa komo yimin aingkiwen kwane nongkobiwen.
Kwane, Baanabas yoom Sool yoom yaa od kondiiwa yimbed wene anam andidan yi korok korok Yudea aom doriib yaa kondiwen.
